title: Publish whole-task benchmark and holdout protocol
notes: benchmarks/task/mbr-804.v1.schema.json, docs/evaluation/whole-task-benchmark.md (base version), scripts/qualification/verify-whole-task-benchmark.mjs, and tests/benchmarks/whole-task.test.mjs were already present on this tree from an earlier, evidence-incomplete pass at this same task (commit 672a9c4b, message 'MBR-804: add whole-task benchmark protocol'): a receipt schema and a fail-closed verifier, but no corpus, no holdout protocol, and no harness. This task adds the missing whole-task benchmark harness (benchmarks/whole-task/runner.mjs), a synthetic fixture corpus unmistakably labelled as a fixture (benchmarks/whole-task/corpus.fixture.json), a genuine commit-reveal holdout split protocol (benchmarks/whole-task/holdout.mjs), an immutable read-only reference to the already-completed vector-backend bakeoff that never reruns it (benchmarks/whole-task/bakeoff-reference.mjs), a CLI entrypoint (scripts/qualification/benchmark/run-whole-task-benchmark.mjs), their tests, an extension of the existing doc, and these evidence files on top of that base without altering the existing schema, verifier, or test file's behavior (all three were only read/imported, never modified — out of this task's allowlist).

The strict allowlist given for this task (benchmarks/whole-task/**, scripts/qualification/benchmark/** as a new subdirectory only, evidence/benchmarks/**, docs/evaluation/whole-task-benchmark.md, evidence/productization/MBR-804/**) is narrower than the dispatch-manifest's allowedPaths (benchmarks/**, scripts/qualification/**, evidence/benchmarks/**, docs/evaluation/**); this task honored the narrower, explicit set and did not touch benchmarks/task/**, benchmarks/memory/**, tests/benchmarks/**, scripts/qualification/run.mjs, scripts/qualification/verify-whole-task-benchmark.mjs, scripts/qualification/memory/**, or any other docs/evaluation/*.md file. evidence/benchmarks/** was not used: neither of the two established lanes this task was told to follow (MBR-801, MBR-805) use that path, and this task's own evidence lives under evidence/productization/MBR-804/** per the four required deliverables.

The manifest command node scripts/qualification/run.mjs --task MBR-804 was not executed: per MEMBRANE-BOOK-MODE-EXECUTION-RULES.md, manifest commands run once at the final phased book gate (Gate phase 3.1 — Wave 3 phase), not at task-implementation time; the script also belongs to the concurrent MBR-801 lane and is out of this task's allowlist.

No cargo/pnpm/Tauri build, no mutating git command, and no dataset download or network call was performed. The vector-bakeoff artifacts consumed (engine/vector-bakeoff/config/round1-v1.json, engine/vector-bakeoff/fixtures/smoke-v1.manifest.json, docs/benchmarks/vector-backend/2026-08-02-rust-vector-optimization-bakeoff-2-report.md, and both docs/benchmarks/vector-backend/round1/{mac,windows}/receipt.json files) were only read and sha256-hashed, never executed, rerun, or regenerated.
